releaseNote.summary: The state function's transitions[].view.loadData now carries the loadData declared on the transition's view binding, so a form declared loadData: false opens empty.

migrations.title: State function honours a transition view binding's loadData
migrations.description: Each transitions[] entry of the state function now answers view.loadData with the value declared on the transition's view binding (the first entry's, since the state function does not evaluate view rules). Before, a transition outside an active subflow always answered true, so a form declared loadData: false opened pre-filled with the record's data, and a parent-added shared transition listed while a subflow is active always answered false (vnext#1266). A subflow's own entries now carry what the subflow declares instead of true. A binding that declares no loadData, and a transition without a view, answer as before. StateFunctionCache.ResponseShapeVersion moved to v15, so parked long-pollers receive the corrected body once.
migrations.action: None required. A binding that declares loadData: false and relied on the form being pre-filled must declare loadData: true. Mapping-side clearing added as a workaround for stale form values can stay or be removed.
